description: Test suite for DeepLinkAgentPolicy, validating message length, delivery effectiveness, and channel handling in DeepLinkAgentPolicy.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicyTests
classes.description: Test suite containing multiple test cases for DeepLinkAgentPolicy functionalities.

methods.name: validate message for handle rejects too long when unkeyed
methods.description: Tests that messages exceeding maxUnkeyedConfirmChars are rejected when allowUnattended is false.

methods.name: validate message for handle allows too long when keyed
methods.description: Tests that messages exceeding maxUnkeyedConfirmChars are accepted when allowUnattended is true.

methods.name: effective delivery ignores delivery fields when unkeyed
methods.description: Checks that delivery is suppressed and 'to' and 'channel' are defaulted when link has no key and allowUnattended is false.

methods.name: effective delivery honors deliver for deliverable channels when keyed
methods.description: Verifies that delivery settings are respected when link has a key and allowUnattended is true.

methods.name: effective delivery still blocks web chat delivery when keyed
methods.description: Ensures that delivery to webchat channels remains blocked even when key is present and allowUnattended is true.
